"""Generate a mixed 64-line batch, run the planner, verify everything."""
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, "/app/work")

import gen, gen2, gen3, gen_struct, maxcase


def make_feasible(inst):
    for e in inst["edges"]:
        e["capacity"] = min(1024, e["capacity"] * 8)
    for c in inst["commodities"]:
        c["demand"] = c["demand"] // 4
    inst["budget"] = 98304
    return inst


def batch(seed):
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    out = []
    # 8 gen.py
    for i in range(8):
        out.append(gen.gen_instance(rng, i, big=(i % 4 == 3)))
    # 12 gen2 mixed
    for i in range(12):
        mode = ["feas", "tight", "big"][i % 3]
        out.append(gen2.gen(rng, mode))
    # 14 gen3 constructed feasible
    for i in range(14):
        out.append(gen3.gen_feasible(rng, big=(i % 4 == 3), tight=(i % 2 == 0)))
    # 20 structured
    for i in range(20):
        g = gen_struct.GENS[i % len(gen_struct.GENS)]
        inst = g(rng, rng.randint(0, 2147483647))
        if i % 2 == 0:
            inst = make_feasible(inst)
        out.append(inst)
    # 8 maximal
    for i in range(8):
        kind = ["plain", "infeas_budget", "infeas_mlu", "infeas_fail", "tight"][i % 5]
        out.append(maxcase.build(rng, kind))
    return out


def main():
    seed = int(sys.argv[1])
    reqs = batch(seed)
    lines = ("\n".join(json.dumps(r, separators=(",", ":")) for r in reqs) + "\n").encode()
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "/app/submission/planner.py"],
                       input=lines, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()[:2000]
    open("/app/work/_req_b.jsonl", "wb").write(lines)
    open("/app/work/_res_b.jsonl", "wb").write(p.stdout)
    if p.stderr:
        print("stderr:", p.stderr.decode()[:600])
    import fullcheck  # runs main on import args; do it manually instead
    fullcheck.main.__globals__["sys"].argv = ["x", "/app/work/_req_b.jsonl", "/app/work/_res_b.jsonl"]


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
    fullcheck.main()
PYEOF
cd /app/work && sed -i 's/^fullcheck.main.__.*$//' campaign.py && time python campaign.py 5001
